package.name: warehouse_demo
package.description:
The warehouse, executed by ePlanSys.
The floor is the RoboticsAcademy multi-robot Amazon warehouse; the mission is to bring the pallet to the dock and to know which bay it came out of. Which bay that is nobody knows at the start, so the plan is a policy: the robot looks, and what the map then says decides which branch runs.
This package supplies the two things the planning stack cannot: actions that move and look, and a node that starts the mission. Everything else is ePlanSys configuration -- the EPDDL pair, the classical domain the executor dispatches on, the mapping between the two vocabularies, and the regions perception reads the map over.
